name: Half-Elf
summary: Born between two worlds, half-elves mix human drive with elven grace. Many feel at home everywhere and nowhere, and get by on charm and versatility.

age.summary: Half-elves mature like humans and can live past 180 years.

alignment.summary: Half-elves value freedom and creativity and often lean chaotic.

size.description: Half-elves are about the same size as humans, 5 to 6 feet tall.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish.

features.name: Darkvision
features.summary: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of gray only).

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.summary: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: Skill Versatility
features.summary: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

features.name: Extra Language
features.summary: You can speak, read, and write one more language of your choice.
